rationale: Amend: you overruled the HRV call, so I have taken it out as a brake. You feel fine, have no symptoms, and the load is tiny; I have said the risk once (an unexplained slide can precede illness, so the neck check stands) and will not re-argue it. What changes: 23–29 Nov goes 44→47 km and 30 Nov–6 Dec 52→56 km, both provisional. What does NOT change: 16–22 Nov stays ~38 km, because that is the ramp cap off a 30 km week and the calf, not HRV. The calf is the one gate left, and Tuesday 17 Nov is its test. If it is felt again, this proposal is wrong and we hold. The rest of the week 16–22 Nov is unchanged.
